kind: predeclared finite implementation slice; not a replacement taskbook
intent: set_date_serial(sheet, existing cell, serial, explicit DateSystem)
semantics: Persist numeric serial with existing unambiguous date style; no calendar conversion or rendering. Serial 60 in 1900 system is preserved as a compatibility serial, never normalized to a Gregorian date.

accepted.style: explicit cell s index; unique styles part/owning workbook relationship; selected cellXf with explicit true applyNumberFormat, supported attributes, no children and xfId absent/0; no conditionalFormatting or tableParts on target sheet
accepted.numeric_dependents: A1 serial; B1=A1+1 and Report!A1=Dates!B1; exact expected serial+1

refused: mismatched system even when numeric value equals current value
missing/out-of-range style index, wrong/duplicate style owner, wrong content type
applyNumberFormat missing/false; general or time-only format; arbitrary custom format; builtin override or duplicate custom format id
selected xf inheritance outside absent/0, children, foreign attributes or extension semantics
formula/error target, merged target, conditionalFormatting/tableParts, or existing preserving-edit refusal
state_contract: Validate date system/style before no-op; equal numeric intent preserves raw bytes/lexical spelling, revision, redo and save point. Failed request preserves every session state component. Changes use existing candidate/recalc/history/save logic.

values and dependent caches after each serial input, undo/redo, source/unrelated parts/date1904/style byte preservation
